book.name: 2 Tesalonaika
book.title: Fut kale Fol em Auk Teben Fut Tesalonaika Abiw Mutuk Fian em Sios Kawtiw ilo Dabalayemse Fut kale.

content: Sunbin-Got eso Weng Bakamoliwka!

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Yu nukalem fefe weng kale kililoliwka! Yu Sunbin-Got eso weng bokolomeliw: “Kamok Fian ku Fol so akalem angin iso, alik alik ilo dokoyemewi, i kom weng be iti boko, iti boko, aneng aneng angom kalo de unoliwka!”, dangboliwka! Dangeko, Kamok Fian beem weng be yom kanesliw atew, kawtiw ka biliw kawtiw biim kiin dim akati wiin fian so kuloke te.

Keko beli, yu Sunbin-Got elo bokolewomeliw: “Ku Fol so akalem angin iso, alik alik ilo dokoyemew kasike, i wa kukuw so kawtiw im teing dim nam kuaniw te!”, dangboliwka! Nimtew angom? Mali kawtiw banso mak Sunbin-Got elo “Fein!”, danginba kebiliw kawtiw keko, nulo maka keyemkabiliw kasike.
Kate, Kamok Fian e kiol kuw em sen mongom kayak kasike, e yulo dokoyemoke te. E yulo yemkitilmoloke kasike, Seten-Ataanim e yulo nam banim keyeme te.

Feinka! Nu Kamok Fian so, akalem dokoyemin kukuw beso, alik alik be atin kuw kal keluw kasike, nu kilele kal keluwete: E yukati dokoyemoke kasike, yu num yulo kukuyemsuluw weng be diwkuw diwkuw aluweko, gelewkabilw bakate.

Kamok Fian e yulo yauleko, yom ibolow tem be kiol kuw yemde unemomaka! Kaneyemoke kasike, yu Sunbin-Got em ibolow fian keyembe kukuw so, Kulais em yulo yemkitilmobe kukuw beso, alik alik be atin kuw kal keko, yu beem dim kel kakamoliwka!
Aluwbamin em Weng te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Nu num Kamok Fian Yesus Kulais em wiin dim kel weng kitil weng kale bokoyemomeluw: Yu kanelom sak dus nam teinbomi, nukalem yulo kukuyemsuluw weng beem kukuw gelewinba kekabiliw fein ibolow so kunum waneng im mit mewso unemokoliw te!
Yu num yuso bisuluw ding dim beem kanemaluw kukuw be atemeko, num sak kuw teinbinba kebisuluw beemdiw yukati keboliwka!

Fein! Beem ding dim bakate, taw banim kutiliw banim diwkuw diwkuw nu kun kuluko, bukesomi, nukalem ete num wanin webisuluw te. Nimtew angom? “Num dulum elote yulo ilum mak nam duyemuw kai!”, angenaluw kasike.

Yu kililina! Ken kukuw em sawa weng e alik alik nu kal keluwete: “Num aluwkabuluw beem yan be nulo fein dukayemboliwka!”, angei, nu kal kebuluw te. Kate, nu kukuw be gelewinba kebomi, yom yamtolo bin kunum kebuluw kasike.
Nimtew angom? Num yuso bisuluw ding dim bakate, nu yulo kitil weng bokoyemomeluw: “Aulinba kebiliw kunum i kanelom wanbokoliw te!”, yangbisuluw kasike.
Kate kame, nu weng mak kililuwete: “Mali yom mutuk ka biliw kunum waneng mak aulinba kesomi, sak teinbomi, weng anyam bakakayem tem bakayem tem de kakabiliw kai!”, yangiwi, nu kilisuluw te.
Kanebiliw kawtiw yu Kamok Fian Yesus Kulais em wiin dim kel num yangbuluw weng kale kilele kililoliwka! Yu menew falit teinbomi, yukalem teing dim kuw feneko, boliwka!
Nakunum kumel kunum waneng alik alik yutaka! Yu kanelom ken kukuw gelewemomin beem dulum elote gal kemokoliw te!

Yu nukalem fut kaleem kukuyembuluw weng kale sakalaw keko, weng bo bo kelewbiliw kunum waneng ilo kilele kal kemoliwka! Kal keko, ilo yetefoneko, singam kel boliwka! Kaneliwi, i ikalem kanebiliw kukuw beelo diweko, inkal kelokoliw kasike.
Kate, yu kanelom kakunum kumel biilo maka emdiw keyembokoliw te! Itel bate! I yukalem kakunum kumel kebiliw kasike, yu ilo ibolow tem tem weng kuw bakayemboliwka!
Fefe Weng te.
Yutaka! Ibolow menew em sen mongom kayak Kamok Fian be yulo diwkuw diwkuw ibolow menew fian mak keyemboka! Kamok Fian be alik alik yuso boka!

Fol nakalem ete fefe weng kale nakalem teing so boli te. Nakalem fut alik alik bi fefe weng beemdiw mak boli kasike, yu weng be teing bokoko, diweko, kal keliwete: “Fein! Fut kale Fol akalem teing ninik kai!”, angbokoliw te.
Nukalem Kamok Fian Yesus Kulais em ibolow folok e alik alik yuso boke te! Bete kuw. Num fut weng boyemuw fut be kame kilaka.
